<cite ref="Chullin 84b">Ib. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>כסא דפשורים</he> some ed. (read: <he>רֵי …</he>, or <he>רִין …</he>); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 29b:23">B. Mets. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>דפושרין</he> (some ed. <he>דפשרין</he>), v. <cite ref="H01789"><he>חַרְשִׁין</he></cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 73b:4">Kidd. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>פִּשְׁרֵי יש בו וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>פושרי</he>) if a child is found in shallow water formed by melting snow (where no ship can pass), it is legally considered a foundling.
